answer_calendar: The calendar compacts workdays, shows configured holidays and opens a date’s details without overloading the grid.
answer_default: I can guide you to the journal, drafts, calendar, profile, settings, reports or institutions. Support can take over for a specific request.
answer_drafts: Every new day is saved automatically in drafts until publication. You can resume or delete each draft.
answer_institutions: Global institution creation belongs to the Control Center. The institution can then invite administrators, teachers, supervisors and students according to permissions.
answer_journal: A new day can reuse the previous location and context, then receive links, images and documents within the configured limits.
answer_oauth: Google, GitHub, Microsoft and Apple cards remain visible. A card shows “Setup required” until its provider is enabled in Supabase and NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_PROVIDERS.
answer_profile: The profile now groups identity, contact details, biography and professional links. Settings no longer repeat this data.
answer_reports: Reports and exports use published days. Drafts remain excluded until publication.
answer_settings: Settings control theme, density, currency, country, region, time zone, holidays and pagination.
scope_notice: This local guide does not send your data to an external model and does not replace human support.
title: Practicora Guide
typing: The guide is writing a response
welcome: Hello! I can help you find a feature and understand how Practicora works.
